_comment: PREVIEW deploy config for the Carli work-in-progress link. Copy this into the deploy staging directory as vercel.json at deploy time. Do NOT place it inside staging-v1/clean/ - that is the frozen, hash-verified artifact and adding files to it breaks the freeze. Do NOT edit the repo-root vercel.json, which serves the main site and has outputDirectory '.' - deploying that would publish _wip/, docs/orchestration/ and every internal evidence file to a URL the client can browse.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://use.typekit.net; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com https://use.typekit.net https://p.typekit.net; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'
